key_decisions.decision: Preserve every leadership category in a readable list within the verse.
Retain the standing posture, familial address, rest, and footstool image.
Keep the explicit condition alongside the forever promise.
Preserve the reciprocal seeking, inward scrutiny, and severe alternative.
Choose Spirit while noting the possible in-his-mind reading and keep both treasury categories.
Keep the chariot image and clarify its apposition to the cherubim without replacing it.
Retain writing, the divine hand, and understanding without asserting a particular mode of inscription.
